scope_prototype: Short normalized literal stable-context span may use query-shared qualification. Free-form output requires exact observation-scoped attestation; without a declared future exact-observation reuse, skip GPU qualification. No output rewriting and no gold-label admission.
pass_probability: Estimate joint early-eligibility and backend passing from observed references/responses; source-cluster bootstrap lower 10th percentile, 2000 draws, seed10672132. Correlated repeats and queries remain in the same source unit.
marginal_saving: Calibrate paired backend TTFT difference per actual prefill-token reduction, not raw total TTFT per input token. Report these as development predictors, validate all performance with actual full wall.
cost_components: actual complete qualification including rejected requests
nonnegative matched raw-witness latency difference as a conservative logprob cost diagnostic
tail_budget_reference: Observed development raw global p99 by model. Estimated baseline-family p95 TTFT plus predicted complete qualification must fit; this forecast is not a hard runtime guarantee.
pre_gate: Cheap family/model/registered-reuse check before candidate tokenization or business logprob request; preparation CPU cost is still measured.
reuse_hint_boundary: Fixed ten-turn benchmark declaration, not observed future model outputs or production query frequency.
development_selection: First reject configurations with observed compiled material loss or zero non-RULER coverage. Then prefer measured full-wall benefit subject to no demonstrated tail worsening. Preserve all tried variants and fallback quality. Do not treat offline proxy optimization as serving evidence.
scheduling: Keep a matched original-wave control. Independent-session or asynchronous qualification is a separately declared candidate; raw/policy share arrivals and scheduling, and background drain remains inside full cost.
